title: feat(spec): an action's param dialog can name its own submit verb — `submitText`
body:
🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

https://claude.ai/code/session_017ihL2fi9zfJhUTubyJYb6V

Fixes #27944

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json, skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 动作元数据新增一个可选键 `submitText`：动作收集参数的对话框里提交按钮上的文字（可翻译，字符串或内联多语言映射）。翻译位在 `objects.OBJECT._actions.ACTION.submitText`，`translateAction` 会套用译文。没有 `params` 的动作写这个键会被拒绝（它根本不会打开参数对话框），空字符串也被拒绝；翻译包里给无参数动作写这个键，`os validate` 报 `translation-target-unknown`。
- **为什么改：** 参数对话框的按钮永远写「Confirm / 确认」，发邮件、记录通话这类动作没法说「Send」「Log Call」。这是规格的一半；控制台对话框读取这个键在后续卡 #28158，本 PR 先落地。
- **风险与回滚：** 只加可选键，不写它的动作解析与显示都不变。控制台读取落地前没有渲染方读它（存活账本记为 planned，作者会收到 planned 提示）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。**键名需要你批准：** 我用了 `submitText` 而不是派发时提议的 `submitLabel`，理由见下文 The name；`submitLabel` 与 `confirmLabel` 作为别名改名到它。若你要 `submitLabel`，改名是机械的一次提交。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`（新键、空白拒绝、无 params 拒绝、别名），`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`（`translateAction` 只在有 params 时套用译文），`packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts`（`checkActionSubmitText`）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/action-submit-text.test.ts`，预期 18 个用例全部通过，其中一条断言无 params 的动作写 `submitText` 被拒、路径为 `submitText`。
- **需要你做的：** 批准键名 `submitText`（或指定 `submitLabel`），之后席位落地。

## What changes

**`ActionSchema.submitText`** (`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`), an optional key declared beside `params`. It is the label of the submit button in the dialog an action opens to collect its params ("Send", "Log Call"), in place of the dialog's default "Confirm".

- **The name (the maintainer approves it here).** The order proposed `submitLabel`; measured on `549203d040`, the protocol already has a word for a submit button's copy, `object-form`'s `submitText` (`I18nLabelSchema`, beside `cancelText` / `nextText` / `prevText`, `component.zod.ts`). `submitLabel` is a spelling the platform retired twice in favour of that one: the `element:form` prop (`18.ui__ElementFormProps__submitLabel` tombstone) and the page component-copy translation key (`translation-component-submit-label-removed`, whose refusal tells the author "the live form surface's submit copy is `object-form`'s `submitText`"). Reintroducing `submitLabel` as a live key here would teach the word those refusals point away from. It does not collide with `confirmText`: that is the MESSAGE of the confirm dialog a param-LESS action opens; this is the BUTTON of the param dialog, and the two never meet on one registered action (see the refusals).
- **The shape.** An I18nLabel: a plain string with the `NON_BLANK_STRING` refinement (so the JSON Schema carries `minLength` + a `\S` pattern too), or `InlineLocaleMapSchema`. A blank string is refused, since it would replace "Confirm" with an empty button.
- **Only beside a non-empty `params`.** The console's action runner opens the param dialog only for a non-empty `params` array, so `submitText` on any other registered action would parse clean and never show: refused at path `submitText` (ADR-0078's authoring-time rule, the mirror of the existing `confirmText`-beside-`params` refusal). Not picked onto `InlineActionSchema`, which does not pick `description` either.
- **Aliases.** Exactly two, both measured on a neighbouring surface and neither reachable by distance (probed: the fallback offers nothing for either): `submitLabel` (above) and `confirmLabel`, the same button's spelling on a view's `bulkActionDefs` dialog. Both rename onto `submitText` on the action and in a translation bundle.
- **Translation.** `actionTranslationSchema` declares `submitText` at both addresses (`objects.OBJECT._actions.ACTION`, `globalActions.ACTION`). `translateAction` overlays it like `description`, but only for an action that declares a non-empty `params`, the way `resolveActionResultDialog` reads nothing for an action with no dialog.
- **Lint.** `validateTranslationReferences` gains `checkActionSubmitText`: a `submitText` translation under an action that declares no `params` is `translation-target-unknown` at `error` (the result-dialog leaves' rule, with `params` as the declaration). The action-entry coverage pin classifies the new key as `reference-checked`, backed by a ghost at both addresses.
- **Liveness.** Row `submitText` is `planned` + `authorWarn` until the console reads it (#28158 flips it). The metadata form ledger records the key as an `omit` row ("planned, not yet rendered", the `page.print` / `field.conditionalFormatting` precedent), so the Studio action form does not offer a control nothing draws; #28158 deletes that row and adds the form row.
- **Forced neighbours.** `ui/packages/core/src/actions/actionKeys.ts` lists `submitText` in `SPEC_ACTION_KEYS` (its pin walks the spec's `ActionSchema`; without it `Test UI` reds). `packages/metadata-protocol`'s `/meta/types` action key count pin moves 48 → 49 and its sample names the key.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` gains "Naming the submit button: `submitText`" under Action Parameters and the property listing line; `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx`'s action row names the new copy.
- **Changesets.** `@objectstack/spec` minor (both declaration lines), `@objectstack/lint` patch, `@object-ui/core` patch (`Metadata-protocol: none` on both).

The console half is **#28158** (`domain:ui`, label `finding`): both param-collection handlers resolve the key, `ActionParamDialog` draws it with `actionDialog.confirm` as the fallback, `UIActionSchema` derives it, the ledger row flips to `live`, and the action form offers it. It lands after this PR.

Independent review: none run (quota); the PR waits for the seat's contract-review hand-off.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/ui/action-submit-text.test.ts` (new, 18): string and locale-map parse; optional; non-I18nLabel shapes refused as `label` refuses them; blank and whitespace refused (`code` `custom`, path `submitText`, message first sentence); refused without `params` and with `params: []`; both aliases rename (`unrecognized_keys`, `→ submitText`); not on the inline action; translation slot at both addresses, alias inside a bundle; `translateAction` overlays per locale, reads `globalActions`, falls back to the authored label, resolves a bundle label for an action that authors none, and gives no button to an action without params.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.test.ts`: `submitText` under param-less actions errors at both addresses (rule, severity, path, message first sentence); accepted under an action with params (control); coverage table entry + the all-keys real-instance control.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts`: count 49, sample names `submitText`.
- `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`: `action` / `submitText` omit row.

## Acceptance notes

- `os i18n extract` (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`) does not scaffold `submitText` yet; `description` and `disabledReason` are scaffolded there. Left out because `packages/cli` is outside this card's claimed file surface; a bundle written by hand resolves today. The seat decides whether it rides #28158 or its own card.
- A view's `bulkActionDefs` dialog already has its own button label key, `confirmLabel` (a plain `string`, not an I18nLabel); this PR does not touch that surface.
